records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the Metropolitan Police Service Dedicated Ward Officer Abstractions and Strengths dataset. The dataset is aggregated to Team level by month and includes Month, BCU, Borough, Borough Code, Team, Abstracted from Duty, Abstraction Type and Abstracted Minutes. Since 27 November 2025 it also includes a Ward Codes column; the publisher cautions that these codes are derived from team names and may not precisely align with the exact areas covered. The current published file covers August 2021 through July 2026 and is updated monthly. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that official operational source without extracting a team subset, parcel geometry or local spatial join.
